column1: # REGISTER 4 (PARTIAL) — mutation-proofs.partial-atom.tsv
# Scope: ONLY the assertions added to reference-impl/tests/test_atom_coverage.py in this wave, to
# close the defect guard-domains.tsv records against that file: "23 of 44 shipped modules are
# named. An atom that exists in code but is absent from IMPLEMENTED is neither required to be
# documented nor detected." A later wave merges these rows into mutation-proofs.tsv.
# CORRECTION TO REGISTER 3. The reach was 21 of 44, not 23 — 47.7%, not 52.3%. Recomputed
# mechanically from the file at HEAD df27363: the modules test_atom_coverage.py imports or reads
# are the 18 IMPLEMENTED keys, plus landforms (via GENERATORS) and dunes + isostasy (via FAITHFUL).
# 23 is the size of the COMPLEMENT — the modules the guard does NOT reach. guard-domains.tsv is
# frozen and outside this wave's write scope, so the correction is recorded here and in the report.
# HOW EVERY ROW BELOW WAS OBTAINED. Each mutation was APPLIED to the subject (a reference-impl
# module, or ATOM-COVERAGE.md — never the test), `python -m pytest tests/test_atom_coverage.py -q`
# was run, the failing test name and the assertion's own first line were pasted into `observed`,
# and the subject was restored from a byte-for-byte backup. `git status --porcelain` was checked
# clean of module changes afterwards. Nothing in `observed` or `decoy_observed` is predicted.
# STANDING FAILURE, PRESENT IN EVERY RUN BELOW AND FILTERED OUT OF THE OBSERVATIONS.
# test_documented_module_has_no_undocumented_public_symbol[flow] fails on the UNMUTATED tree, on
# ['breach_fill', 'hybrid_accumulation']. Both are public routing atoms in flow.py; neither appears
# anywhere in ATOM-COVERAGE.md, and chapter 03 calls the hybrid of the two "the right default for
# terrain generation" (references/03-flow-routing.md:101). hybrid_accumulation landed in commit
# d03bf86 on this branch, breach_fill was still uncommitted when this guard first ran. That is a
# REAL instance of the defect class this wave exists to close, caught on the guard's first run, and
# it is deliberately NOT exempted.
# ONE EXEMPTION WAS DRAFTED AND WITHDRAWN, which is worth recording because it is the failure mode
# this whole register exists to catch. SYMBOL_EXEMPT["flow"]["hybrid_accumulation"] was first
# written as "composition of the documented mfd_accumulation and d8_accumulation" — plausible
# prose, and it turned the row green. It was withdrawn on evidence: chapter 03 promotes the hybrid
# to the recommended default, and the routine's own author recorded it as undocumented. An
# exemption that makes a guard green on the first real defect it finds is the guard papering over
# its own subject. SYMBOL_EXEMPT["flow"] is now empty, by comment, and the count fell 58 -> 57.
# The fix is a doc edit, not a test edit: one code span per atom in ATOM-COVERAGE.md's solver
# paragraph, plus both names in IMPLEMENTED["flow"].
# COLUMN CONTRACT
#   mutation          the exact edit introducing the defect class (subject file, before -> after).
#   expected_observation  what the guard was predicted to do, written before running.
#   observed          what it actually did: failing test id + the assertion's first line.
#   decoy             a legitimate edit of the SAME SHAPE that the guard must NOT fire on.
#   decoy_observed    what actually happened on the decoy.
#   verdict           PROVEN when mutation went red AND decoy stayed green; DECORATIVE when no
#                     edit to a subject can turn the assertion red.
